meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把原始数据套进「Setup→Conflict→Resolution」叙事框架，产出带图表、业务上下文和行动建议的洞察报告与演示文稿。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或准备投资人演示，需要把数据讲给非技术受众听时触发。

say.text: 把这份季度营收数据讲成给高管听的故事
用叙事框架整理这份客户流失分析
say.note: 会补上图表与行动建议

say.text: 把市场机会分析写成投资人演示的六页流程
say.note: 按数据故事流程逐页组织

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude shapes raw data into the Setup→Conflict→Resolution frame, producing insight reports and decks with charts, business context, and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Use when presenting analytics to executives, running quarterly business reviews, or building investor decks for non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly revenue data into a story for executives
Reframe this churn analysis with the narrative framework
Write the market opportunity analysis as a six-slide investor flow
say_en.note: Follows the data story flow template
